source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The update test head temporarily supplies a fake absolute executable path so the update sync manager does not mistake the test parent for another running Thunderbird instance. It sets directory-provider persistence false, resets the lock, then unregisters the provider immediately. It also suppresses update timers and restores auto-update state, notifications, files and the lock during cleanup. The page test restores Services.appinfo and the external protocol mock. Preserve the short-lived directory override; leaving it installed affects unrelated update work. This is static inspection of the fixture, not an executed update or restart.
title: Update tests isolate executable identity and restore global services
